en.content:
Who We Are

Vanguard Studio is a next-generation digital engineering and design collective that eliminates the bloated bureaucracy, endless delivery delays, and exorbitant budgets of traditional software development. We build high-performance digital storefronts for small businesses, independent professionals, and SMEs operating in domestic and global markets. We don't just launch websites; we elevate your brand’s digital prestige, execution velocity, and cybersecurity benchmarks to global standards.

Why We Were Founded (Our Digital Revolution)

The current digital landscape forces enterprises to choose between two highly inefficient extremes: traditional creative agencies demanding months of development alongside non-transparent retainers, or low-cost website builders that yield amateur, low-converting templates riddled with security vulnerabilities.

Vanguard Studio was engineered to bridge this divide with a bulletproof business model. We align our engineering focus and design aesthetics on three unshakeable pillars:

  • A Curated 10-Site Master Portfolio: There is no room for clutter in our ecosystem. We strictly select, engineer, and optimize a maximum of 10 elite sectoral blueprints, battle-tested for user experience (UX) and maximum client conversion.
  • Guaranteed 48-Hour Turnkey Deployment: The exact moment corporate assets and technical permissions are validated by our team, our 48-hour (2 business days) deployment countdown officially begins. From domain DNS routing and cloud hosting configuration to Cloudflare Enterprise SSL activation and business emails, your full digital asset is deployed live within 48 hours.
  • Transparent, Accessible Fixed Budgets: The {{PRICE_10000}} – {{PRICE_20000}} ranges announced across our catalog represent fixed, one-time software and setup fees. At Vanguard Studio, there are zero surprise renewal bills, hidden platform expenses, or recurring licensing costs for the source code.

Our Global Operational Core Values

  • Zero Technical Headaches (Managed Ecosystem): We eliminate the tech overhead for business owners. Under our "Agency Managed" tier, all server maintenance, data security audits, and content updates are fully handled by the Vanguard Studio desk via simple messaging.
  • Authentic Bilingual Globalization: We strictly reject amateur automatic machine translation widgets. To protect your brand authority in international markets, our entire architecture supports Turkish (TR) and English (EN) languages via pristine, manual client-side data input panels, stored in completely secure systems.
  • Next-Gen Clean Code (React & Tailwind Stack): We do not deploy bloated third-party plugins that compromise website velocity. Utilizing React and Tailwind CSS web technologies, we consistently hit 95+ scores on Google Lighthouse metrics. Our platforms feature native Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) to ensure next-gen AI search utilities (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini) easily index and source your website directly.

"This Data Protection and Privacy Notice is governed by and construed in accordance with the general principles of international commercial law (UNCITRAL), the European Union E-Commerce Directives, the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK) No. 6698, and the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), ensuring full compliance with cross-border and domestic digital data processing standards, and is legally binding upon the parties."

1. Data Controller and General Principles

As Vanguard Studio ("Company"), we attach the highest priority to the security and protection of your personal data processed within the scope of your activities on our website (https://vanguardstudio.digital) and our content management panel (CMS). This notice has been prepared in full compliance with KVKK and GDPR standards to inform you about the purposes for which your data is collected, stored, transferred, and your legal rights.

2. Processed Personal Data and Methods of Collection

Your personal data is collected via our website request forms, client CMS panels, official WhatsApp support lines, and corporate communication channels through fully or partially automated methods for the execution and performance of a contract. Within this scope:

  • Identity and Contact Data: First name, last name, corporate email address, phone number, billing and corporate company details.
  • Technical and Content Data: Corporate logos, brand identity assets, service texts, and server/panel access permissions delivered to our team for your project launch.
  • Network Server and Log Data: Data automatically transmitted by your browser to ensure server stability, including IP address, date/time of access, browser type, operating system, and internet service provider domain.
  • Financial Data: Order payments are processed securely via our PCI-DSS protected global infrastructure partner, Stripe. Your credit or debit card details are never held, stored, or processed on Vanguard Studio servers.

3. Purposes and Legal Bases for Data Processing

Your personal data is processed based on the legal grounds of "performance of a contract," "compliance with a legal obligation," and "the legitimate interests of the Company" pursuant to KVKK Article 5 and GDPR Article 6 for the following purposes:

  • To deliver the software, design, and engineering services provided through the website and to execute our 48-hour delivery commitment,
  • To run the Autosave (automatic draft registration) and Local Browser Mirroring (LocalStorage/IndexedDB) systems on the management panel to prevent data loss resulting from session timeouts or network disruptions,
  • To issue official e-archive invoices and process product and service fees,
  • To notify you about new packages, promotions, and campaigns, provided that you have granted your express consent,
  • To ensure cybersecurity and optimize system defense against malicious activities via our Cloudflare Enterprise infrastructure.

4. Data Transfers to Third Parties and Cross-Border Transfers

Your personal data may be transferred to our legal, financial, and tax consultants, auditors, our global cybersecurity and CDN partner Cloudflare Enterprise, and our PCI-DSS compliant secure payment gateway Stripe in accordance with data security standards to fulfill legal obligations and perform the service agreement. Since no external automatic translation engines are deployed on our platform, the TR and EN contents you enter manually are stored strictly within our isolated secure server network.

5. Your Rights as a Data Subject

Under KVKK Article 11 and GDPR provisions, you have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, request information if processed, know the third parties to whom data is transferred domestically or internationally, request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data, and demand the complete deletion of your data (Right to be Forgotten) from our systems.

6. Exercise of Rights and Contact

To exercise your rights mentioned above, you may submit your requests along with documents verifying your identity in writing or via notary to our corporate address, or through secure electronic mail to info@vanguardstudio.digital.

Regulatory Compliance and Legal Framework Statement:

"This Cookie Policy is governed by and construed in accordance with the general principles of international digital commerce, the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK) No. 6698, ensuring full compliance with cross-border data protection and local e-privacy regulations, and is legally binding upon the parties."

1. Data Controller and General Principles

This Cookie Policy ("Policy") explains the types, purposes, legal bases, and management of cookies used during visits to the website operated by Vanguard Studio ("Company"). Our Company covenants that all data processing activities on our website are conducted in full compliance with the KVKK and GDPR standards.

2. What is a Cookie?

Cookies are small text files saved onto your computer, smartphone, or other devices when you visit a website. Cookies are utilized to ensure the secure and stable operation of the website, remember user preferences (language, region, etc.), analyze website performance, and display customized advertisements.

3. Types of Cookies Used and Legal Grounds

Cookies used on our website are categorized by their retention periods (session or persistent) and ownership (first-party or third-party), and are processed based on the following legal grounds:

  • Strictly Necessary / Technical Cookies: Required for fundamental operations such as secure connection, page navigation, and privacy preference management. The website cannot function stably without them. Legal Basis: Formation/performance of a contract and the legitimate interest of the Company. Explicit consent is not required.
  • Performance and Analytical Cookies: Anonymously analyze how visitors use the website, which pages are visited most, and technical errors encountered (e.g., Google Analytics). Legal Basis: Explicit Consent provided by the user via the Cookie Consent Banner upon entering the site.
  • Functional Cookies: Remember user preferences such as language selection or region settings from past visits to offer a personalized experience. Legal Basis: User's Explicit Consent.
  • Targeting and Advertising Cookies: Third-party cookies used to analyze users' online behavior and display customized advertisements (e.g., Stripe security/verification cookies). Legal Basis: User's Explicit Consent.

4. Data Processed via Cookies and Third-Party Transfers

Direct identity data (such as name and surname) are not stored through cookies on our website. However, device information, IP addresses, geographical location data, browser types, clickstream paths, and user identifiers (IDs) are processed automatically. This data may be processed across the secure server networks of our global infrastructure partners, such as Cloudflare Enterprise (security and CDN) and Stripe (PCI-DSS protected secure payment gateway), in accordance with global data security standards.

5. Cookie Management and Deletion by the User

Visitors can freely select which cookies they consent to via the Cookie Consent Preference Panel displayed upon their initial visit. All checkboxes for non-essential cookies are set to "disabled" by default (Opt-in principle). Users can also delete previously saved cookies or block them entirely through their browser settings (Google Chrome, Safari, Firefox, etc.). Please note that blocking cookies may affect the optimal performance of certain advanced functions on our website.

6. Enforcement and Updates

This Policy is periodically updated by Vanguard Studio to align with legislative or technical infrastructure changes.

Fiyatlara Katma Değer Vergisi (KDV) dahil değildir; faturalandırma aşamasında yürürlükteki yasal KDV oranı fiyatlara ilave edilir. Resmi e-arşiv fatura Alıcı'nın kurumsal e-posta adresine iletilir.
  • 3.2. Ödeme Altyapısı: Ödemeler PCI-DSS korumalı global Stripe altyapısı üzerinden kredi/banka kartıyla veya Satıcı'nın resmi banka hesaplarına FAST/Havale yoluyla yapılır. Havale sonrası dekont resmi WhatsApp hattına ulaştığında finans ekibince ödeme onaylanır ve sipariş başlatılır.
  • 3.3. Periyodik Maliyetler: Satın alınan yazılımların kaynak kodları için ömür boyu ikinci bir ücret talep edilmez. Sitenin açık kalması için gereken tek periyodik maliyet, yıllık olarak şeffafça faturalandırılan bulut sunucu (hosting) ve kurumsal e-posta barındırma masrafıdır.
  • 3.4. Güvenlik Sertifikası (SSL): Cloudflare Enterprise altyapısıyla sağlanan 256-Bit SSL sertifikası, Alıcı'nın yıllık hosting hizmeti Satıcı bünyesinde aktif olduğu dönemlerde paket kapsamında ücretsiz yenilenir; harici sertifika bedeli alınmaz.

MADDE 4 - TESLİMAT VE OPERASYON ESASLARI

  • 4.1. 48 Saat Taahhüdü: Gerekli tüm kurumsal içeriklerin (logo, metin, görsel) ve teknik erişim izinlerinin Satıcı teknik ekibine eksiksiz teslim edilip onaylanmasıyla yalnızca hazır şablonlu ekonomik paketler için 48 saatlik (2 iş günü) yayına alım süreci başlar.
  • 4.2. Gelişmiş Paket İstisnası: Süreç yoğunluğu ve özel mühendislik aşamaları nedeniyle, Profesyonel Paket (Tam Yetkili CMS) ve Özel Talep & Kurumsal Mimari paketleri bu 48 saatlik taahhüdün kesinlikle kapsamı dışındadır. Bu projelerin teslim takvimi proje bazlı ek sözleşmelerle (Statement of Work - SOW) belirlenir.
  • 4.3. Gecikme Cezası İfası: Satıcı iç teknik süreçlerinden kaynaklanan gecikmelerde ilk yıl barındırma (hosting) bedeli Satıcı tarafından karşılanır. Bu hediye hizmet, gecikmeden doğabilecek tüm doğrudan veya dolaylı zararların yerine geçer; Alıcı nakit iadesi hakkı doğurmadığını kabul eder. Harici alan adı aktivasyon süreleri, ödeme kapısı onayları ve müşteri kaynaklı bilgi/revizyon gecikmelerinde sayaç durdurulur.
  • 4.4. Revizyon ve Kabul: Site canlıya alındığı an 7 günlük ücretsiz revizyon süreci başlar. Bu sürede metin, görsel yerleşimi ve iletişim güncellemeleri ücretsiz yapılır. 7. günün sonunda proje eksiksiz kabul edilmiş sayılır. Sonraki talepler yıllık teknik destek sözleşmesine tabidir.
  • 4.5. Panel Dil ve Veri Güvenliği: Panel, dışarıdan otomatik çeviri motoru içermeksizin sadece manuel olarak girilecek TR ve EN dillerini destekler. Veri kaybını önlemek amacıyla panelde 30 saniyede bir otomatik taslak kaydı (Autosave) ve tarayıcı yerel hafıza (LocalStorage/IndexedDB) yedeklemesi çalışır.

MADDE 5 - CAYMA HAKKI İSTİSNASI (İADE KOŞULLARI)

İşbu Sözleşme konusu hizmet; Alıcı'nın istekleri ve kişisel/kurumsal ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda hazırlanan, elektronik ortamda anında ifa edilen ve Alıcı’ya anında teslim edilen gayri maddi (dijital) nitelikte bir yazılım ve tasarım hizmetidir. 6502 sayılı Kanun ve Mesafeli Sözleşmeler Yönetmeliği Madde 15/ğ bendi ile AB Tüketici Hakları Direktifi (Directive 2011/83/EU) uyarınca, elektronik ortamda anında ifa edilen hizmetler ve tüketiciye anında teslim edilen gayri maddi mallara ilişkin sözleşmelerde cayma hakkı kullanılamaz. Alıcı, sipariş ve ödeme onayının ardından iade ve iptal talebinde bulunamayacağını gayrikabili rücu kabul ve beyan eder.

MADDE 6 - UYUŞMAZLIKLARIN ÇÖZÜMÜ

İşbu Sözleşme’nin uygulanmasından ve yorumlanmasından doğacak tüm hukuki uyuşmazlıklarda Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Kanunları uygulanacak olup, uyuşmazlıkların çözümünde Satıcı'nın tescilli merkezinin bulunduğu yerdeki İstanbul (Çağlayan) Mahkemeleri ve İcra Daireleri münhasıran yetkilidir.

Regulatory Compliance and Legal Framework Statement

"This Distance Sales Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the general principles of international commercial law (UNCITRAL), the European Union E-Commerce Directives, the Turkish Code of Obligations (TBK) No. 6098, and the Law on Consumer Protection No. 6502, ensuring full compliance with both cross-border and domestic digital service regulations, and is legally binding upon the parties."

ARTICLE 1 - PARTIES

1.1. SELLER (Service Provider):

    • Commercial Title: Vanguard Studio
    • Website: https://vanguardstudio.digital
    • Email: info@vanguardstudio.digital

1.2. BUYER (Client):

Any real or legal person who purchases digital packages, ready-to-use templates, software, or engineering services offered through the Company's website and fills out the information at the billing stage.

ARTICLE 2 - SUBJECT AND SCOPE OF THE AGREEMENT

The subject of this Agreement is to determine the rights and obligations of the parties regarding the sale and delivery of digital agency, web design, software development, and engineering services ordered electronically by the Buyer through the Seller's website, the specifications and sales prices of which are stated on the website.

ARTICLE 3 - PRICING AND PAYMENT TERMS

  • 3.1. Net Budgets and VAT: All budgets announced on the website are one-time software/setup fees and represent net amounts pursuant to tax legislation. Prices do not include Value Added Tax (VAT); the statutory VAT rate in force will be added at the billing stage. Official e-archive invoices are sent to the Buyer's corporate email address.
  • 3.2. Payment Infrastructure: Payments are processed securely via our PCI-DSS protected global infrastructure partner, Stripe, using international credit/debit cards, or via 24/7 FAST/wire transfer to the Seller's official bank accounts. Orders are initiated once the finance team validates the wire transfer receipt via the official WhatsApp line.
  • 3.3. Recurring Costs: No secondary fees are charged for the software source codes life-long. The only recurring cost required to keep the website active is the annual cloud server hosting and corporate email hosting fee, which is billed transparently.
  • 3.4. Security Certificate (SSL): The 256-Bit SSL certificate provided through Cloudflare Enterprise is renewed free of charge within the package scope during the periods when the annual server hosting service is actively maintained under the Seller; no separate certificate fee is charged.

ARTICLE 4 - DELIVERY AND OPERATIONAL TERMS

  • 4.1. 48-Hour Commitment: Upon the complete delivery and validation of all required corporate content (logos, text, images) and technical access permissions to the Seller's technical team, the 48-hour (2 business days) deployment process officially commences exclusively for our ready-to-use templated economic packages.
  • 4.2. Advanced Package Exclusion: Due to architecture complexity and dedicated engineering phases, the Professional Package (Full-Authority CMS) and Custom Request & Enterprise Architecture packages are strictly excluded from this 48-hour delivery commitment. These projects are independently governed by project-specific Statements of Work (SOW).
  • 4.3. Liquidated Damages: For delays arising solely from internal technical processes of the Seller, the first year of server hosting fees will be fully covered by the Seller. This complimentary service remedy constitutes the sole satisfaction for delays and explicitly excludes any cash refund claims. The timer shall be paused during domain activation latencies, external payment gateway approvals, and client-side revisions.
  • 4.4. Revision and Acceptance: A 7-day complimentary revision period initiates immediately when the website is launched live. Corrections regarding texts, image layouts, and contact updates are performed free of charge. Upon the expiration of the 7th day, the project is deemed fully accepted, and subsequent requests are subject to the annual technical support contract.
  • 4.5. Panel Language & Security: The CMS panel exclusively supports Turkish (TR) and English (EN) for manual data entry, deploying no external automatic machine translation engines. To prevent data loss, an automatic draft registration system (Autosave every 30 seconds) and local browser mirroring (LocalStorage/IndexedDB) are executed.

ARTICLE 5 - EXCLUSION OF THE RIGHT OF WITHDRAWAL (REFUND POLICY)

The service subject to this Agreement constitutes a digital, intangible software and design service customized in accordance with the Buyer's requests and corporate needs, executed instantly in an electronic environment, and delivered to the Buyer immediately. Pursuant to Article 15/ğ of the Distance Contracts Regulation and the European Union Consumer Rights Directive (Directive 2011/83/EU) regarding contracts for the supply of digital content and services executed instantly online, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised. The Buyer irrevocably accepts and declares that no return or cancellation requests can be submitted following the order and payment confirmation.

ARTICLE 6 - DISPUTE RESOLUTION

Any legal disputes arising out of the implementation or interpretation of this Agreement shall be exclusively governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey, and the Courts and Execution Offices of Istanbul (Çağlayan) shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

faqs.question: Satın aldığım web sitesinin kaynak kodlarını ve tam mülkiyetini teslim alabiliyor muyum?
faqs.answer: Bu durum tamamen tercih ettiğiniz hizmet modeline bağlıdır. Profesyonel Paket (Tam Yetkili CMS) modelini tercih eden müşterilerimiz, tüm kaynak kodlarını ve bağımsız web paketini tek tıkla indirerek tam mülkiyet hakkını devralabilirler. Ekonomik Paket (Yönetim Bizde) modelinde ise yazılım, tasarım ve kaynak kodlarının mülkiyeti ile bulut barındırma hakları tamamen Vanguard Studio güvencesinde kalır; harici kaynak kod teslimi yapılmaz.

en.question: Can I take delivery of the source code and full ownership of the website I purchased?
en.answer: This depends entirely on your chosen service model. Clients who select the Professional Tier (Full-Access CMS) can download their full source codes and independent web bundle with a single click, taking over complete ownership rights. In the Economic Tier (Managed by Us), the ownership of the software, design, and source codes remains entirely under Vanguard Studio framework; independent source code delivery is not provided.

ru.question: Как быстро сдаются готовые сайты и как проходит процесс?
ru.answer: В зависимости от выбранной конфигурации готовый веб-сайт запускается в течение от 24 до 48 часов. После привязки вашего домена сайт публикуется с полной адаптивностью и активным SSL-шифрованием. Доступы к панели управления передаются вам по e-mail или WhatsApp.

faqs.question: 48 saatte anahtar teslim garantisi nasıl çalışıyor, gecikme olursa süreç ne oluyor?
faqs.answer: Gerekli tüm kurumsal içeriklerin (logo, metin, görsel) ve teknik erişim izinlerinin ekibimize eksiksiz teslim edilip onaylanmasıyla yalnızca hazır şablonlu ekonomik paketlerimiz için 48 saatlik yayına alım süreci resmen başlar. Profesyonel CMS ve Özel Kurumsal Mimari paketleri bu taahhüdün dışındadır. Bizden kaynaklanan mücbir sebepler dışındaki gecikmelerde, ilk yıl sunucu barındırma (hosting) bedeli firmamızca tamamen ücretsiz karşılanır. Bu hizmet ifası gecikmeden doğabilecek tüm maddi/manevi zararların yerine geçer; nakit iadesi hakkı doğurmaz. Domain aktivasyonları ve harici ödeme kapısı onaylarında sayaç durdurulur.

en.question: How does the 48-hour turnkey delivery guarantee work, and what happens if there is a delay?
en.answer: Upon the complete delivery and validation of all required corporate content and technical access permissions to our team, the 48-hour deployment process officially begins solely for our ready-to-use economic packages. Professional CMS and Custom Enterprise projects are excluded from this timeline. In the event of internal technical delays on our part (excluding force majeure), the first year of hosting fees will be fully covered by our company. This service remedy constitutes full satisfaction for delays and excludes cash refund claims. The timer is paused during domain activation latencies and third-party payment gateway approvals.

ru.question: В чем основная разница между Эконом и Профессиональным тарифом?
ru.answer: В модели Эконом серверы, обновления безопасности, SSL и техническое обслуживание находятся под управлением экспертов Vanguard Studio; вы просто направляете нам материалы. В Профессиональном пакете вы получаете доступ к CMS для независимого редактирования контента, фото, товаров и меню.

faqs.question: Yıllık aidat, gizli yenileme maliyeti veya ek bir masraf var mı?
faqs.answer: Hayır, Vanguard Studio’da hiçbir gizli masraf veya sürpriz fatura yoktur. Sitemizde ilan edilen bütçeler tek seferlik yazılım ve kurulum ücretidir; yani kodlar için ömür boyu ikinci bir ücret ödemezsiniz. Sitenizin internette açık kalması için gereken tek periyodik maliyet, bulut sunucu (hosting) ve kurumsal e-posta barındırma masrafıdır. Bu ücret de tamamen şeffaf bir şekilde yıllık hosting faturası olarak yansıtılır. Cloudflare Enterprise altyapımız sayesinde sağlanan 256-Bit SSL güvenlik sertifikası, yıllık sunucu barındırma hizmetinizin aktif olduğu dönemlerde paket kapsamında ücretsiz olarak yenilenir ve ayrıca bir sertifika bedeli alınmaz.

en.question: Is there an annual fee, a hidden renewal cost, or any additional expense?
en.answer: No, there are no hidden costs or surprise bills at Vanguard Studio. The prices listed across our platform cover one-time software and setup fees; meaning you never pay recurring fees for the code itself. The only recurring cost required to keep your site online is for cloud server hosting and corporate email hosting, which is billed transparently on an annual basis. Thanks to our Cloudflare Enterprise infrastructure, the 256-Bit SSL certificate is renewed free of charge as part of your package for as long as your annual hosting service remains active, and no separate fee is charged for the certificate.

ru.question: Какие способы оплаты вы принимаете? Выдаются ли чеки и договоры?
ru.answer: Для платежей из Турции используются Банковский перевод / FAST. Для клиентов из РФ и СНГ доступна оплата через СБП (Система быстрых платежей) и Т-Банк. Все сделки сопровождаются официальными договорами и закрывающими документами.

faqs.question: Sitenin içeriğinde fiyat, fotoğraf veya iletişim bilgilerini değiştirmek istediğimde ne yapacağım?
faqs.answer: Ekonomik Paket (Yönetim Bizde) modelini seçtiyseniz, panel şifreleriyle vakit kaybetmezsiniz. Değişiklik talebinizi WhatsApp üzerinden ilettiğinizde teknik ekibimiz revizyonu aynı gün sitenize işler. Profesyonel Paket (Tam Yetkili CMS) modelinde ise, sitenizin altına entegre edilen modern ve sadeleştirilmiş Müşteri CMS Paneline şifrenizle giriş yaparak; hiçbir kod bilgisine veya ajans koordinasyonuna ihtiyaç duymağan hizmetlerinizi, fiyatlarınızı ve çalışma saatlerinizi saniyeler içinde kendiniz güncelleyebilirsiniz.

en.question: What should I do if I want to change the prices, photos, or contact information on the site?
en.answer: If you choose the Economic Tier (Managed by Us), you won't lose time dealing with web panel access. Simply forward your request via WhatsApp, and our technical crew implements the revision live on the same business day. If you select the Professional Tier (Full-Access CMS), you can log into the intuitive, simplified Client CMS Panel integrated into your footer using your private password to update your services, pricing, and business hours within seconds entirely by yourself, requiring zero technical expertise.

ru.question: Могу ли я привязать свой существующий домен к веб-сайту?
ru.answer: Да, вы можете привязать свой собственный домен (например, yourcompany.com). Наша команда инженеров предоставляет бесплатную помощь по настройке DNS и привязке домена.

faqs.question: Sitenin Google'da ve yeni nesil yapay zekâ arama motorlarında üst sıralara çıkması için bir optimizasyon var mı?
faqs.answer: Evet, web sitelerimiz sadece klasik Google botları için değil, en yeni nesil yapay zekâ arama motorları (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini) için de özel olarak tasarlanmış Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) ve Üretken Motor Optimizasyonu (GEO) mimarisine sahiptir. Siteniz, yapay zekanın doğrudan kaynak gösterip cevap üretebileceği atomik bir metin yapısıyla ve 95+ Google Lighthouse hız skoruyla teslim edildiği için aramalarda rakiplerinizin önüne geçersiniz.

en.question: Is there any optimization in place to help the site rank higher on Google and next-generation AI search engines?
en.answer: Yes, our web systems are engineered from the ground up with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) architectures, tailored specifically for next-generation AI search utilities (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini) as well as classic Google crawlers. Because your platform is delivered with a structured, atomic paragraph layout designed for direct AI source attribution and paired with a 95+ Google Lighthouse speed score, you will seamlessly outperform your industry competitors.

ru.question: Оптимизирован ли сайт для поисковых систем Google и Yandex (SEO/GEO)?
ru.answer: Все готовые веб-сайты по умолчанию оптимизированы согласно стандартам GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) и традиционному SEO. Код настроен на максимальные показатели Google PageSpeed, включая метатеги, карты OpenGraph и микроразметку Schema.org.
